hack.root_cause: Auth bypass in Factory minting contract — sloppy signature check bypassed with fresh addresses
hack.description: ChainSwap lost $4.4M when its per-token Factory minting contracts could be called by anyone using a fresh address per transaction — bypassing an authorization check that required no proof of legitimacy.
